rules.name: User story format
rules.description: Story must be written in 'As a [user], I want [goal], so that [benefit]' format

rules.name: Acceptance criteria defined
rules.description: Story must have at least one acceptance criterion

rules.name: Story points estimated
rules.description: Story must have story points assigned (not 0 or null)

rules.name: Priority set
rules.description: Story must have a priority (High, Medium, Low)

rules.name: No unresolved dependencies
rules.description: All blocking dependencies must be resolved or scheduled

rules.name: Design attached (if applicable)
rules.description: If UI changes are involved, a design link or attachment must be present
